description: This file contains ASN.1 related data structures, functions for creating, manipulating, verifying, encrypting, and matching public keys (RSA, DSA, DH), and key pair management in ASN.1 format. It specifically defines objects such as PublicKey, RSAPublicKey, DSAPublicKey, DHPublicKey, and KeyPair, with associated methods for handling cryptographic key operations in a platform-independent manner.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_PUBLICKEY
classes.description: A choice object representing a public key which can be DSA, RSA, or DH public key.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_RSAPUBLICKEY
classes.description: RSA public key structure comprising modulus and public exponent.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_DSAPUBLICKEY
classes.description: DSA public key represented as an integer.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_DHPUBLICKEY
classes.description: DH public key structure represented as an integer.

classes.name: ANSC_ASN1_KEYPAIR
classes.description: A sequence containing key type, public key, and private key info.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE AnscAsn1PublicKeyCreateSelection(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG index)
methods.description: Creates a specific key object (DSA, RSA, or DH) based on the selection index.

methods.description: Verifies a signature with the public key, supports RSA and DSA keys.
